Quiet, hopeful mood despite the decay. Melancholic indie film mood with cinematic widescreen framing. Composition: the left 40% of the frame stays calm and soft (hazy sky, wall, shadow or distant silhouettes) for a headline; the subject sits in the right half; horizon in the lower third; characters full body at human scale. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no border, no film grain.
